    • getAllFields

      public static Map<Class<?>,Field[]> getAllFields(Class<?> clazz)
      Get all the fields that are present in members of a given class. Recursively checks up into the class tree of clazz to accumulate members.
      Parameters:
      clazz - to analyze
      Returns:
      all the fields that members of clazz have.

      public static int checkEnclosing(Class<?> left, Class<?> right)
      Check if one of the given classes is enclosing the other.
      Parameters:
      left - left class
      right - right class
      Returns:
      -1 if the left one encloses the right one 0 if none are enclosing the other 1 if the right one encloses the left one
